verdict.rationale: Sift is an API-driven SaaS platform, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows separate Sandbox and Production REST API keys per account. That is environment separation, not per-agent or permission-scoped credentials, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
